basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Air conditioners (split system)
basis.note: Printed page 43. Split-system air conditioners. In New Zealand this class is dominated by ductless wall/ceiling splits; also covers ducted split condensing units. BDFO Building fit-out (when in books separately from building cost). Printed DV 20%, SL 13.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
